# Security

For a vulnerability in this index or its build scripts, use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/polang233/dsh-plugin-index/security/advisories/new). Include a reproduction and the affected URL or commit. Do not post tokens or exploit details in a public issue.

For a vulnerability in a listed plugin, contact that plugin's maintainer. You can request temporary removal from the index without disclosing exploit details.

The generator reads published packages without installing or executing them. Integrity and manifest checks do not establish that a plugin is safe to run. The website uses local assets and has no analytics or account system.

## 中文

索引或构建脚本的漏洞请通过 [GitHub 私密漏洞报告](https://github.com/polang233/dsh-plugin-index/security/advisories/new)提交，附复现步骤和受影响的地址或提交。请勿在公开 Issue 中发布密钥或利用细节。

收录插件的漏洞请联系该插件作者，也可申请暂时移除条目。生成器只读取发布包，不安装或执行插件；完整性和清单检查不代表插件可以安全运行。网站使用本地资源，不设置账号或访问统计。
